name: list_revisions
description: List Draft and Released Revisions for a Product manual ID, including retired Products. Returns immutable identities and exact explicit selections. Read-only; no preparation, selection or lifecycle changes.

name: read_revision
description: Read a Revision by Product manual ID and Revision immutable internalId. Draft members are the complete calculated outgoing closure; Released members are frozen retained evidence, including recorded area information. Explicit roots and indirect members remain distinct; multiple exact versions of one entity are preserved. Read-only; never substitutes current versions or changes a baseline.

name: change_draft_link
description: Change one ordinary link owned by the current editable Draft. Never use in review mode. Requires explicit human approval of relationship and exact owner/old/new endpoints, then confirmed=true. ownerKind: requirement, test-case or feature. relationship: user-need, parent, verifies or addresses (respectively Requirement–User Need, child–parent Requirement, Test Case–Requirement, Feature–Requirement). operation: add, remove or retarget. Supply ownerId, ownerVersionId and positive expectedRevision from a prior read, plus targetId and targetVersionId (old endpoint for retarget). Retarget requires replacementVersionId of the same target entity; omit otherwise. No creation, provenance or lifecycle changes. Never automatically retry; after any uncertain outcome retrieve authorized current state before a human-directed retry.

name: explore_relationships
description: Read incoming/outgoing relationships from an exact User Need, Requirement, Test Case or Feature version. kind: user-need, requirement, test-case or feature. Only explicitly requested reachable expandedVersionIds are expanded (at most 20); repeated versions load once. limit defaults to 100, range 1-200, independently caps edges and unavailable provenance snapshots. Truncation is disclosed; results are not a complete transitive closure. No mutations.

name: create_draft_feature
description: Create an incomplete Draft v1 with no links. Optional null title/description default to empty. Requires explicit human approval of initial values. Never automatically retry; list/read candidates after uncertain creation, and do not blindly recreate an ambiguous result.

name: edit_draft_feature
description: Fully replace exact Draft content using its positive expectedRevision. Requires explicit human approval of old/new content. Preserves generated identities and links. No lifecycle/link changes. Never automatically retry; retrieve before user-directed retry after uncertain outcomes.

name: list_features
description: List all Features for a Product manual ID, including retired Products. Selects working version otherwise latest Approved; ordering is not guaranteed.

name: read_feature
description: Read a Feature, all version summaries and retained entity history. Optional versionId selects exactly that version; otherwise working or latest Approved. Retrieve before retrying uncertain writes.

name: create_draft_requirement
description: Create a Draft Requirement under an active Product manual ID. Requires a Product-unique manual ID (at most 100 Unicode characters), title, Markdown statement and explicit type: System, Software, Hardware, Safety, Usability or Regulatory. Rationale is optional plain text. Never automatically retry; retrieve before manually retrying uncertain outcomes.

name: create_draft_test_case
description: Create an incomplete unclassified Draft v1 with no links. Optional null content defaults to empty. Never automatically retry; list/read candidates after uncertain creation, and do not blindly recreate an ambiguous result.

name: create_draft_user_need
description: Create a Draft User Need under an active Product's manual ID. Required: Product-scoped ID, title and Markdown statement. Never automatically retry a write; after an uncertain result, list/read before manually retrying.

name: edit_draft_requirement
description: Replace Draft Requirement content only. Supply immutable internalId and expectedRevision from a prior read, manual ID, title, Markdown statement and explicit type: System, Software, Hardware, Safety, Usability or Regulatory. Omitted/null rationale clears it. Rejects stale writes, non-Draft states and retired Products. No status/review changes. Never automatically retry; retrieve before manually retrying uncertain outcomes.

name: edit_draft_test_case
description: Fully replace exact Draft content using its positive expectedRevision. Preserves identities, links and classification. No lifecycle/link changes. Never automatically retry; retrieve before user-directed retry after uncertain outcomes.

name: edit_draft_user_need
description: Edit Draft content only. Supply immutable internalId and expectedRevision from a prior read. Stale writes, non-Draft content and retired Products are rejected. No status/review/version changes. Never automatically retry; retrieve before manually retrying uncertain outcomes.

name: list_products
description: List Products, including retired Products. Product information is read-only through MCP.

name: list_requirements
description: List Requirements in all statuses for a Product manual ID, including retired Products. Returns immutable entity/version identities, working/latest-Approved designations and concurrency revision tokens.

name: list_test_cases
description: List all Test Cases for a Product manual ID, including retired Products. Selects working version otherwise latest Approved; ordering is not guaranteed.

name: list_user_needs
description: List User Needs in all statuses for a Product's manual ID, including retired Products. Returns immutable identities and revision tokens.

name: read_product
description: Retrieve a Product by its manual productId, including its full Markdown description and active/retired status. Cannot modify Products.

name: read_requirement
description: Read Requirement content, versions and retained decision history by immutable internalId. Optional versionId selects exactly that version, never latest substitution. Otherwise returns working version or latest Approved. Retrieve before retrying uncertain writes.

name: read_test_case
description: Read a Test Case, all version summaries and retained entity history. Optional versionId selects exactly that version; otherwise working or latest Approved. Retrieve before retrying uncertain writes.

name: read_user_need
description: Read User Need content, versions and decision history by immutable internalId. Optional versionId selects exactly that version, never latest substitution. Otherwise returns working version or latest Approved. Retrieve before retrying uncertain writes.
